name: kisansetu-workspace
description: KisanSetu - Smart Farmer Procurement & Queue Management System (SIH 2026)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
